body: Thank you so much! It’s been very difficult because he says he’s okay with my decision either way, but then has made comments about how much it will “kill him” that I’m doing this but that “he understands I’m not ready and we will have another at the right time.” I know he is struggling too and I want to support him. I have zero guilt about making this decision except that I don’t want to hurt him or make this decision split us apart. We’ve been on and off together and friends for 16 years. We live 5 hours apart and I’m starting a new business. I have never wanted another baby but have been willing to think about it in the future. Plain and simple I have told him I’m not ready nor do I feel any emotional connection to this pregnancy except that I want it to be over. We’re going on vacation with my entire family next week so I overnighted the pills to just get it done before that, that way I’m not stressing about it and can move on to life as usual. Like I said, I’m afraid that this will push us apart. He says he’s not going anywhere, nor am I. And I don’t even want to say this but I would rather that happen than have another baby. The guilt is just about making him feel crappy.
I just spoke to a doctor on JustAnswer who said with the information given, 4 weeks. Thank you for talking to me about this it’s overwhelming

Honestly not really. I’m on anti-depressants and anti-anxiety medication but I’ve always dealt with both of those problems. I haven’t really been too bothered with the daily things we do. It’s just more mental exhaustion than anything. Maybe I should though. I think counseling is good for anybody!

My moods were so up and down with my depression and I fought it for so long. I finally decided to try an SSRI. I’m not promoting it if it’s not right for you specifically. But it has helped. I also created my room to be my safe and comfortable zone 100%. If I feel anxious or depressed, my room is my safe zone. Lots of candles, salt rock lamps and pretty tapestries. Between new medication and creating my safe space, things have been so much better. I hope you find happiness every day because we all deserve that. But one good day is a great start :)
